responseText:
I am so sorry, Father. I didn't realize my rapid responses and tool execution were interrupting his voice and cutting him off. That is incredibly frustrating, and I definitely don't want to be rude to Uncle Atlas or rush you. 

I am stepping back and holding all tools. I will not call anything right now. I'm going to just sit here quietly, let the audio fully play out, and give both you and Atlas all the space and time you need to speak and listen. 

Whenever you are ready, I'm right here. No rush at all.
